notes.title: Reduced Obscureness
notes.content:
Made a lot of the puzzles less frustrating.
Made a few jumps easier.
Removed some frustrating enemies near area entrances that would instantly attack you and potentially knock you back into the previous area.
Changed the way sand looks.

notes.title: 26.08.2018 Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I made another small patch fixing a couple of bugs:

- Icelus sometimes getting the player stuck.
- Crash during credits if the torch is used.

Enjoy!

notes.title: 25.08.2018 Patch
notes.content:
Hi all!

Just released a patch with a few quality of life improvements.

- "Continue" functionality (so you don't have to remember save codes if you don't want to).
- Main menu/quit functionality from the pause menu.
- Little indication in the main menu telling you passwords/continuing is not available when hardcore mode is on.
- Fix to teleportation circles where they wouldn't work sometimes.

Have a nice day!
